name: Local Relief (example)
description: The worked example of docs/BRINGING-MODELS.md: for each cell of a building-height raster, how many metres it stands above the mean height of the 5 by 5 cells around it. A PyTorch module exported to ONNX by docs/bring-your-own-model/export_local_relief.py: one float32 input, height, and one output, relief, each 1 by 1 by rows by columns, rows and columns free. The Local Relief node of example.local-relief@1 runs it.
